judge.printed: Board of Managers (no outside managing agent; the Board, controlled by Sponsor, manages until Sponsor relinquishes control)
judge.quote: Until the Sponsor relinquishes control of the Condominium, the Board shall manage the Condominium.
judge.why: P2 says the first-year budget has no management expense and the Board manages until the Sponsor gives up control. P10 adds there is no outside management company during the Sponsor Control Period, so the condominium is 'effectively' managed by the Sponsor, which controls the board, and charges no fee. C matches. A ('Self-managed') loosely fits but the plan names the Board, and uses 'self-manage' only for the period after Sponsor control. B reflects the 'effectively managed by the Sponsor' wording but not the formal role, which is the Board's.
